defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press before predictable spikes of personal damage to reduce damage taken by 40 percent for 8 seconds; use it proactively for tankbusters and unavoidable raid hits rather than reactively.

defensives.name: Spirit Link Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop on the group ahead of a heavy damage window to cut everyone's damage by 10 percent (15 percent with Spouting Spirits) and redistribute health, keeping low players alive without spending direct healing.

defensives.name: Healing Tide Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a raid-saving cooldown during sustained group damage; its pulsing heal over 10 seconds stabilizes the whole party and is strongest on five or fewer targets.
